old_problem: The historical review treated the OOB command and field interpretation as an unresolved owner contract. IPMI 2.0 sections 31.11a-31.11b and Appendix G define the command, empty request, exact two-byte response, endian order, signed-minute unit, valid range, unspecified sentinel and time conversion semantics. Only target support, secure OOB binding and the Project's timestamped timezone/DST expectation remain runtime configuration, so Pending, Source Conflict and BLOCKED are no longer justified.
disposition_reason: Over the verified secret-safe OOB channel, issue one Storage 0Ah/5Ch request with no data bytes, require completion 00h and exactly two response-data bytes, combine least-significant byte first, recognize 07FFh before signed conversion, otherwise decode two's complement and require -1440 through +1440 minutes. Compare the state to the approved timezone/DST policy effective at the captured instant; when chronology validation is required, apply the approved skew to an independently bracketed UTC/SEL-time comparison. Unsupported is N/A only with authoritative target evidence and cannot be inferred from a LAN/session/privilege failure. Never infer from the client host timezone, clear SEL, set time/offset, borrow IB evidence or retry automatically.
decision_basis: Master XLSX rows 1203-1207, exact same-row DeepSeek, exact GPT second review, tests.json, selection manifest and historical V3.1 record were directly read. The corresponding IB getter at row 1078 and its new review event 223 were read; OOB retains separate target/session/evidence identity. Formal queue sequence 83 was independently verified from XLSX and manifest as row 1206 / variant 30095b90395e299a.
IPMI v2.0 Appendix G assigns Get SEL Time UTC Offset to Storage NetFn 0Ah/Cmd 5Ch. Section 31.11a specifies an empty request and completion code followed by exactly two response bytes.

The response is a 16-bit two's-complement signed integer in minutes from UTC to SEL Time, least-significant byte first. Values -1440 through +1440 are defined; 07FFh is a distinct unspecified sentinel and means SEL time is interpreted as local time.

Section 31.11b fixes the direction: SEL/local time equals UTC plus the offset and UTC equals SEL/local time minus the offset. It also makes software responsible for updating the offset when daylight-saving rules change, so an expectation must be tied to an exact instant and policy.

Get 5Ch is optional in general but mandatory if Set 5Dh is implemented. A documented unsupported implementation may be N/A; an error caused by OOB authentication, cipher, privilege, routing or timeout is not evidence that the command is unsupported.

The standard defines the field but no universal expected value. EXPECTED_SEL_UTC_OFFSET_MINUTES or EXPECT_UNSPECIFIED_07FFH is a bounded Project parameter under ED-34, not a missing engineering definition. Absence makes execution NOT READY and cannot authorize a guessed PASS.

The stored BMC offset cannot be inferred from the automation host's timezone, WebUI display or operator locale. When chronology is in scope, trusted UTC, Get SEL Time 0Ah/48h and an approved skew provide a separate relationship check; the getter itself must not repair a mismatch.

The source's generic log-clear step is rejected because SEL records and their chronology are the evidence this command helps interpret. The read-only procedure preserves SEL/BMC/OS/time-sync context and sends neither 5Dh nor Set SEL Time 49h.

OOB uses a host-verified secret-safe remote endpoint and captures session/channel identity. The byte-level result from IB row 1078 may be compared diagnostically but cannot satisfy this Source Key or replace its OOB transport coverage.

ED-02 preserves Source Key/variant; ED-03 permits the standard command without guessed OEM behavior; ED-13/ED-15 govern N/A and exact acceptance; ED-17 preserves logs; ED-19 separates IB/OOB; ED-30/ED-34 parameterize safe execution; ED-38 prohibits automatic retry and review-time DUT verdicts.

test_case.test_name: IPMI Get SEL Time UTC Offset (OOB Storage 0Ah/5Ch) signed-minute and time-policy validation
test_case.purpose: Read the standard SEL UTC-offset field once through the authenticated OOB path, prove exact wire shape and signed-minute interpretation, and compare it with the approved current Project time policy without changing clocks, offset, logs or the independent IB coverage.
required_package: Approved target BMC/SUT/firmware identity and host-verified secret-safe LANPlus endpoint with credentials supplied outside command arguments
Pinned ipmitool or equivalent raw OOB runner that preserves request, endpoint/channel identity, exit status, completion code, stderr and exact response bytes without hidden retry
Project configuration selecting exactly one of EXPECTED_SEL_UTC_OFFSET_MINUTES in [-1440,1440] or EXPECT_UNSPECIFIED_07FFH, with named timezone, effective timestamp and DST policy
Sentinel-first little-endian/signed parser with unit cases such as 00 00=0, E0 01=+480, 20 FE=-480 and FF 07=unspecified
When chronology accuracy is required: trusted UTC source, paired Get SEL Time 0Ah/48h collector and an approved ALLOWED_CLOCK_SKEW_SECONDS; no default threshold is invented
test_case.test_command: READ-ONLY OOB PROCEDURE; DO NOT EXECUTE DURING REVIEW. Record Source Key/variant and verify the BMC/SUT/firmware, DNS/IP-to-asset mapping, remote channel and privilege without exposing credentials. Preserve SEL/BMC/OS/time-sync evidence and do not run the source log clear. Resolve the approved expectation for the exact instant, including DST. Using host-verified secret-safe LANPlus or an equivalent protected transport, issue exactly one raw Storage request equivalent to `ipmitool -I lanplus -H <BMC> -U <USER> -E raw 0x0a 0x5c`, with no request-data bytes and no retry. Capture exit status, stderr, completion and response; require completion 00h and exactly two response-data bytes B0 B1. Compute U=B0|(B1<<8). If U==0x07FF report UNSPECIFIED; otherwise compute OFFSET_MIN=U when U<0x8000 else U-0x10000 and require -1440<=OFFSET_MIN<=1440. Compare exactly with EXPECTED_SEL_UTC_OFFSET_MINUTES or EXPECT_UNSPECIFIED_07FFH. If chronology validation is required and the offset is specified, bracket one 0Ah/48h SEL-time read with trusted UTC timestamps and verify SEL_TIME=UTC+OFFSET_MIN within the approved skew. Preserve a no-mutation audit and keep row-1078 IB evidence separate.
test_case.expected_result: The verified OOB read succeeds once and returns exactly two response-data bytes. FF 07 is classified only as the 07FFh unspecified sentinel; every other response decodes little-endian as a signed value from -1440 through +1440 minutes. The result equals the Project expectation effective at the captured instant and DST state. Any required specified-offset chronology check meets the approved skew. A required implementation cannot report unsupported, and transport/session failures do not qualify as unsupported. No clock, offset, SEL entry, log or configuration changes.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires the exact OOB Source Key/variant, target and remote-channel identity, 0Ah/5Ch with an empty request, completion 00h, exactly two bytes, sentinel-before-signed decoding, defined range, an approved timestamped expected state and exact match; chronology scope additionally requires the approved UTC/skew comparison. FAIL covers malformed length, endian/sign error, non-sentinel out-of-range value, expected-value or DST mismatch, required-but-unsupported behavior, wrong endpoint, unauthorized mutation, cleared evidence, concealed retry or IB substitution. NOT READY covers missing target/session, runner, expected policy or required skew. N/A requires authoritative proof that optional 5Ch is unsupported and 5Dh is not implemented; an OOB authentication, privilege, network or timeout error is never sufficient.
safety_gate: Bind IP/DNS, BMC certificate or host key where available, chassis serial/FRU and firmware to the intended SUT before the read. Never place a password in process arguments or retained command logs.
Send only Storage 0Ah/Cmd5Ch with an empty request body. Any request data, Set 5Dh, Set SEL Time 49h, clock repair, reset or power action is a different reviewed operation.
Do not clear SEL, dmesg, syslog or time-sync logs. Preserve raw chronology before and after the read; concurrent natural events must be timestamped rather than erased.
Recognize 07FFh before two's-complement/range validation. Do not accept it as +2047, silently map it to zero or guess a timezone from the client host.
Bind the expectation to a named policy and instant so DST transitions are deterministic. Missing policy or threshold is NOT READY, not a permissive comparison.
Issue once and do not automatically retry. On transport, completion, length, decoding or policy mismatch, preserve first-failure evidence and stop without invoking a setter.
This identity is OOB only. Do not cross-credit the local-interface row 1078 even when bytes match; retain both independent execution identities.
expected_evidence: Exact Source Key/variant; BMC/SUT/firmware/FRU and OOB endpoint/channel binding; official sections 31.11a-31.11b and Appendix G authority; distinct row-1078 IB identity
Versioned runner/package hash, credential-handling mode, exact empty request, timestamp, exit status/completion, stderr and unmodified two response bytes
Sentinel-first decode trace showing U and either UNSPECIFIED or signed OFFSET_MIN with range result
Approved Project timezone/sentinel policy, effective instant and DST state with exact expected-versus-observed comparison
When required, trusted UTC and bracketed SEL-time samples, approved skew and calculated SEL=UTC+offset result
Read-only/no-retry command audit, preserved SEL/BMC/OS/time-sync context and final PASS/FAIL/NOT READY/N/A; explicit statement that the review agent executed no DUT action
test_case.recovery: No state recovery is normally required because 5Ch is read-only. On any OOB, completion, shape, decode or policy failure, preserve the first raw response, endpoint identity, timestamps and SEL context, mark FAIL/NOT READY/N/A as applicable, and stop without retry, clock correction, offset write or log clearing. If audit evidence shows an unintended setter or time mutation outside this procedure, quarantine subsequent chronology evidence and hand restoration to the BMC/time owner under the separately reviewed Set identity; this getter must not repair state.

source_conflict.reason: IPMI 2.0 resolves the TBD OOB command, empty request, response size, endian/sign, unit, range, sentinel and time conversion. The Review layer removes contradictory evidence-clearing boilerplate and parameterizes only target support and the timestamped Project expectation.

external_authorities.title: Intelligent Platform Management Interface Specification v2.0 rev. 1.1 E7
external_authorities.application: Sections 31.11a-31.11b, Table 31-1 and Appendix G define optional Storage 0Ah/Cmd5Ch, the mandatory relationship to Set 5Dh, empty request, two-byte little-endian signed-minute response, -1440..+1440 range, 07FFh unspecified sentinel, UTC-to-SEL sign and DST update responsibility.

project_authority: The BMC/time owner supplies target support evidence and the timestamped expected timezone or sentinel policy, including DST and any required UTC/skew oracle, and owns the DUT verdict. Project configuration cannot redefine wire encoding, convert OOB transport failure into N/A, invent a threshold, infer the field from client-host time, merge IB/OOB evidence or authorize this getter to change clocks or logs.
